# Agent Workspace Rules & Guidelines Map

Use this directory map to locate specific code style and technology guidelines depending on which microservice/directory you are working on.

## Guideline Directory Map

- **Go Microservices** (`/listing`, `/media`, `/booking`)
  - Read guidelines in: [guidelines/GO.md](file:///c:/Users/Krystian/dev/RaaS/guidelines/GO.md)
  
- **Java Microservices** (`/payment`, `/review`, `/favorites`)
  - Read guidelines in: [guidelines/JAVA.md](file:///c:/Users/Krystian/dev/RaaS/guidelines/JAVA.md)
  
- **Python Microservices** (`/notification`, `/user`, `/analytics`)
  - Read guidelines in: [guidelines/PYTHON.md](file:///c:/Users/Krystian/dev/RaaS/guidelines/PYTHON.md) (if created)
  
- **Frontend App** (`/ui`)
  - Read guidelines in: [guidelines/TYPESCRIPT.md](file:///c:/Users/Krystian/dev/RaaS/guidelines/TYPESCRIPT.md) and [guidelines/ANGULAR.md](file:///c:/Users/Krystian/dev/RaaS/guidelines/ANGULAR.md)

## General Instructions
1. Before modifying any service, locate its respective guideline markdown file and read it completely.
2. Adhere strictly to the project structure and patterns defined in those files.
